justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/method/ParameterList.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/method/ParameterListExplicitTest.java` (plus `MethodDescription.java` for context). `OfMethod` is a very small nested class: it only has a protected constructor and a single `get(int)` override, while shared behavior is factored into `ForLoadedExecutable` and the legacy/constructor variants are split into separate nested classes. This is a thin adapter for method parameters, not a class with excessive size or multiple poorly separated responsibilities.
